title: Transportability from Honolulu: different outcome mechanism
content: Figure 10.2(f) is a randomized trial with X -> W -> Y and Age Z -> Y, plus selector S -> Y because the product is more desirable in Honolulu. The total effect is not transportable, but the uncontaminated X -> W submechanism can estimate P(W | X).

variables.name: Purchase Decision (Y)
variables.content: The outcome mechanism that differs from Arkansas.

variables.name: Click-through Rate (W)
variables.content: The mediator whose X-to-W mechanism is not contaminated by S.

variables.name: Population Difference (S)
variables.content: The difference-producing selector for Honolulu product desirability.

arrows.because: Figure 10.2(f) retains Age as a cause of Purchase Decision.
Figure 10.2(f) points selector S directly to Purchase Decision Y.
